daily.today_energy: Your vibe is grounded but restless—like you're ready to shake things up. The cosmos is giving you permission to trust your gut instincts today. Channel that steady Capricorn energy into something unconventional.
daily.love: Someone's noticing the real you beneath the professional facade. Whether single or coupled, there's potential for deeper connection if you let your guard down just a little. Vulnerability is your superpower rn.
daily.career: Your ideas are sharper than usual, and people are listening. Don't hold back in that meeting or conversation—your perspective brings value that others haven't considered yet. This is your moment to lead.
daily.health: Your body's asking for movement and fresh air. Even a short walk or stretch session can reset your mental state. Listen to what feels good rather than forcing rigid routines. Flow beats force today.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is inviting you to soften your edges, Cap. The universe is asking you to trust the process instead of controlling every outcome. Let go of perfectionism and see what unfolds when you actually rest.
weekly.love: Venus is whispering something tender your way. Whether you're coupled or solo, this is prime time for authentic connection. Show up as your real self, not the polished version you think people want to see.
